# Introduction {#sec-intro}

Journals and conferences provide LaTeX templates that set the layout of a paper [@lamport1994].
Writing in LaTeX directly, however, mixes content and markup, and code, figures and numbers of an analysis have to be copied into the text by hand.
Quarto renders a Markdown source with embedded code into a PDF via LaTeX [@allaire2022], so that the analysis and the paper stay in one file.

This paper is the sample of four Quarto formats that use the LaTeX classes of the publishers.
@sec-elements shows the elements of a paper, and @sec-notes lists the points to observe.

# Elements of a Paper {#sec-elements}

## Equations

Equations are written in LaTeX and get a label for cross-references.
The root mean square of a signal $x(t)$ with the period $T$ is
$$
X_{\mathrm{RMS}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{T} \int_0^T x^2(t) \, \mathrm{d}t} ,
$$ {#eq-rms}
and @eq-rms is referenced by its label.

## Figures

Figures are included as PDF, so that text and lines stay sharp.
@fig-example shows a damped oscillation with its envelope.

![Damped oscillation and its envelope.](figures/example.pdf){#fig-example width=100%}

## Tables

Tables are written as raw LaTeX in a div with a label, the caption follows the table.
@tbl-example lists the four formats.

::: {#tbl-example}

```{=latex}
\begin{tabular}{@{}ll@{}}
\hline
Format & Publication \\
\hline
\texttt{tpwrd-pdf}    & IEEE Trans. Power Delivery \\
\texttt{oajpe-pdf}    & IEEE Open Access J. Power Energy \\
\texttt{ieeeconf-pdf} & IEEE conferences \\
\texttt{epsr-pdf}     & Electric Power Systems Research \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

Formats of the templates

:::

## Citations

Citations are taken from a BibTeX file and formatted by a CSL style, here the IEEE style.
A single source is cited as [@knuth1984], several as [@lamport1994; @knuth1984].

# Notes {#sec-notes}

Markdown tables are set by Pandoc as `longtable`, which does not work in two columns.
Tables are therefore written as raw LaTeX, or with `knitr::kable(format = "latex")` in R.
The source file has to be in the project root, since the templates read the LaTeX classes from the folder `_extensions`.

# Conclusion

One source renders in four formats, and the layout is set by the classes of the publishers.
